current_behavior:
Storage and constraints. booking_seats carries UNIQUE uq_seat_per_schedule(schedule_id, seat_no) (database/schema.sql:381; confirmed by SHOW INDEX on shari_test), seat_locks carries uq_lock_seat (schema.sql:267), schedule_unit_locks uq_sched_unit, seat_blocks uq_block_seat, agent_ledger uq_ledger_booking_type(booking_id, entry_type) (local SHOW CREATE TABLE). bookings.admin_note exists in the tree (database/upgrade-2026-09-24-bookings-admin-note.sql, `ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS admin_note`) and in the local DB (information_schema listing shows admin_note after cancel_reason); BookingService::cancelSeat writes it (includes/booking.php:2536). Live DB column presence could not be verified (no DB/ssh access), but live = this tree and per-seat cancel would 500 if missing.

Namespaces. booking_seats stores each booking's own MODE label (private cabin "L4" vs sharing beds "L7","L8"); seat_locks stores PHYSICAL beds since 4 Sep (seats.php:1120-1176). Seats::bookedPhysical (seats.php:730-765) joins bookings.booking_mode and expands labels to beds; this is the single occupancy truth for the seat map, the sale gate and DataAudit::seatDoubleBed (dataaudit.php:147-199).

Is a double booking impossible at the DB level? Only for the same label. Seats::claim (seats.php:1363-1392) does `Database::insertIgnore('booking_seats', …)` and throws "Seat X was booked by someone else moments ago" when the row belongs to another booking — InnoDB arbitrates. Cross-mode (private vs sharing on the same mattress) is NOT a DB constraint: the code says so itself (seats.php:1273-1283 "the UNIQUE index on booking_seats alone would not catch them"). It is closed transactionally: Seats::assertAvailable does `Database::fetchForUpdate('SELECT id FROM schedules WHERE id = :s')` then `bookedPhysical($scheduleId, true)` with `LOCK IN SHARE MODE` (seats.php:1283, 1345-1351) inside Database::transaction (db.php:282-345, 3 retries on deadlock/lock-wait/1020). tests/double-booking-race-test.php (6 OS processes, scenarios A-D incl. customer vs counterSale) passes 10/10 locally; cross-mode suites pass 10/32/28.

Paths. Every live sale funnels through BookingService::create (booking.php:98-702): api/book.php (customer and counter mode), admin/seatmap.php:71, admin/new-booking/quick-ticket via QuickTicket::sell/sellCustomer (quickticket.php:717-950, one retry on seat clash), WhatsApp bot (wabooking.php:303 → sellCustomer), OfflineQueue replay (offlinequeue.php:130 → QuickTicket::sell), AI tools (aitools.php: QuickTicket/BookingService only). counterSale (booking.php:762-1040) is the paper register only and takes the same assertAvailable → assertGenderAllowed → claim sequence. Reschedule/missed-bus use performLegMove (booking.php:1392-1470): booking row FOR UPDATE → releaseLeg → assertAvailable → gender → claim → Ticket::reissue. Seat transfer (seats.php:2345-2460) and per-seat cancel (booking.php:2443-2615) run under row locks. Split-pay (api/split-pay.php) only records claims. No file outside includes/seats.php writes seat_locks/booking_seats except through these calls (grep of admin/, api/, cron/, includes/).

Holds and expiry. Seats::lock (seats.php:1044-1178) sweeps expired rows, enforces the party cap (6 public / 20 staff), acquires beds in order with `INSERT … ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE lock_token = IF(expires_at < NOW() OR lock_token = VALUES(lock_token), …)` and rolls back a half-won cabin. Hold = seat_hold_minutes (30, local settings). A pending online booking claims booking_seats immediately with expires_at = now + booking_expiry_minutes (120) (booking.php:467-505); counter/COD bookings get expires_at NULL. submitPaymentProof/attachScreenshot call holdForAdminReview (booking.php:1667-1680) which NULLs expires_at only when real proof exists; cron/expire.php:27-60 re-checks NOT EXISTS UTR/screenshot and expires via a guarded UPDATE (`status='pending' AND expires_at < NOW()`) before releaseBooking — paid-pending-hold-test 14/14. Whether expire.php actually runs on the VPS could not be verified; cron/health-heartbeat.php:45 expects it every 5 min (CRITICAL).

Fares. priceBooking (booking.php:2835-2905): schedules.fare_override wins for sharing; Fare::cabinFare prices sharing by direction (fare.php:101-125, 196-230: toNepal 2000 / toIndia 1800 from settings fare_to_nepal/fare_to_india); Fare::quote applies group → coupon/auto-offer → tier → points → tax → fee (fare.php:640-727). Counter discount is clamped to counter_max_discount_pct (booking.php:427-440).

Refunds. cancel() (booking.php:2230-2325) refunds only when a payments row is 'verified' and status is confirmed, via Fare::refundFor(total_amount, leg.travel_date, r.dep_time) with slabs from settings refund_slabs (local: 96h/90%, 48/75, 24/50, 6/25, 0/0; same source read by legal.php:173). cancelSeat computes perSeatFare = total/liveSeats and accumulates refund_amount. admin/refunds.php approves/denies by editing bookings.refund_amount/refund_status/refund_ref.

Commissions. AgentWallet::accrue (agentwallet.php:1352-1437) runs post-commit for counter sales (booking.php:676), at confirm for online non-COD (1814), at settleCod (1934); it deletes a prior commission_void, inserts one 'commission' row (flat per seat by default: agent_commission_mode=flat_per_seat) and a 'cash_due' row when isCashSale (is_cod or cash method). voidFor inserts the negative row; reassignSeller UPDATEs ownership in place (1526-1660). attributeDeskSale (booking.php:678-742) moves a non-agent desk sale's commission to company_agent_code SHG-0001. commission_agent_only defaults 0 (settings), so office/manager sales still accrue.

gaps.title: Cross-mode double booking is enforced by transaction serialisation, not by a DB constraint
gaps.evidence: includes/seats.php:1273-1283 "two overlapping bookings in different modes have DIFFERENT labels, so the UNIQUE index on booking_seats alone would not catch them — both could pass the read and both claim()"; seats.php:1363-1392 claim() inserts the MODE label; database/schema.sql:13-14 claims "double-booking impossible at the database level". Only assertAvailable's `Database::fetchForUpdate('SELECT id FROM schedules WHERE id = :s')` (seats.php:1283) + `LOCK IN SHARE MODE` (seats.php:745) stand between a private L4 and sharing L7/L8. DataAudit::seatDoubleBed (dataaudit.php:147-199) exists precisely because this can drift.
gaps.proposed_change: Add a physical-bed firewall table `booking_seat_beds (schedule_id, bed VARCHAR(10), booking_id, UNIQUE(schedule_id, bed))` populated inside Seats::claim() from Seats::physicalSeats(label, booking_mode, coach) (claim needs the mode: pass it from create/counterSale/performLegMove/reclaimSeatsFor) and deleted in releaseBooking/releaseLeg/releaseSingleSeat and transferSeat; backfill with an idempotent upgrade (INSERT IGNORE from booking_seats JOIN bookings). Keep assertAvailable as is; the new UNIQUE makes a cross-mode oversell an InnoDB error even if a future path bypasses the gate.
gaps.risk: Schema migration on live data; every seat write path must maintain the second table (transferSeat moves label AND beds). Backfill must run before the constraint is relied on.
gaps.test: Extend tests/double-booking-race-test.php with scenario E: 3 private-L4 vs 3 sharing-L7 racers → exactly one wins, booking_seat_beds has one row per bed.

gaps.title: Gender-lock recompute reads booking_seats labels without the booking mode — a private cabin's label poisons the sharing cabin with the same number (CONFIRMED by probe)
gaps.evidence: includes/seats.php:1576-1620 seatGenders(): `FROM booking_seats bs JOIN booking_passengers bp … WHERE bs.schedule_id = :s AND bs.released_at IS NULL AND bs.seat_no IN (…)` — no join on bookings.booking_mode. seats.php:1764-1790 recomputeUnitsForSeats and :2528 releaseSingleSeat call `self::unitKey((string) $r['seat_no'])` with the default sharing mode (unitKey's own comment at 1507-1520 describes exactly this bug). Rolled-back probe on shari_test: private booking L4 (beds L7+L8, Female) → `Seats::recomputeUnitLock($sid,'L-2','sleeper')` → schedule_unit_locks L-2 = 'female_only' → `assertGenderAllowed(…, ['L3'], ['Male'])` REFUSED "This shared cabin already has a female passenger" although beds L3/L4 are physically empty. Trigger: any release/transfer/edit in cabin L-2 while a private L4 exists.
gaps.proposed_change: In seatGenders() JOIN bookings b and exclude `b.booking_mode = 'private'` rows (private cabins are exempt from the rule and occupy different beds) — or expand each row through Seats::physicalSeats(seat_no, b.booking_mode, coach) and keep only rows whose beds intersect unitSeats(). In recomputeUnitsForSeats()/releaseSingleSeat()/releaseBooking() pass the booking's mode to unitKey() (the mode is one scalar away: bookings.booking_mode).
gaps.risk: Low — only changes which rows feed the recompute; the create path (assertGenderAllowed) is unaffected.
gaps.test: tests/gender-lock-test.php: add 'private L4 (Female) next door does not lock sharing cabin L-2'; re-run cross-mode-seat-sync-test.

gaps.title: Refund bookkeeping on bookings.refund_amount is overwritten / re-opened across per-seat cancels and the final cancel — an already-paid refund can be shown as due again
gaps.evidence: includes/booking.php:2529-2534 cancelSeat: `$newRefundTotal = round($existingRefund + $refund['amount'], 2); … 'refund_status' => $newRefundTotal > 0 ? 'pending' : …` — if seat 1's refund was already 'processed' (paid) by admin/refunds.php, seat 2's cancel sets refund_amount = paid + new and status back to 'pending', so the desk shows the paid portion as due again. booking.php:2279-2280 cancel(): `'refund_amount' => $refund['amount'], 'refund_status' => $refund['amount'] > 0 ? 'pending' : 'none'` overwrites whatever per-seat refund was accumulated/processed. admin/refunds.php:60-64 pays `$amount` from that single column.
gaps.proposed_change: Keep a per-event refund ledger: new table `booking_refunds (id, booking_id, seat_no NULL, amount, status pending|processed|denied, ref, created_by, created_at)`; cancelSeat/cancel INSERT a row, refunds.php processes rows (not the booking column); bookings.refund_amount becomes a derived SUM for display. Minimal interim fix: in cancelSeat never regress 'processed' → 'pending' (if $locked['refund_status']==='processed' store the new seat's refund separately and audit it) and in cancel() add to, not overwrite, an existing pending amount while leaving processed amounts untouched.
gaps.risk: Money path; needs a backfill for bookings whose refund_status is already processed. The current per-seat-cancel-test is source-inspection only, so a DB-backed test must be written.
gaps.test: New DB-backed case: 3-seat confirmed+verified booking → cancelSeat(A) → approve refund → cancelSeat(B) → desk shows only B's amount pending; then cancel() → only the remaining seat's slab is pending; total refunded never exceeds total paid.

gaps.title: Staff and operator cancellations apply the customer penalty slabs — $byCustomer only changes the notification label
gaps.evidence: includes/booking.php:2246-2273 computes `Fare::refundFor((float) $booking['total_amount'], …)` unconditionally; the only use of $byCustomer is booking.php:2297 `$actor = $byCustomer ? 'customer' : 'admin';`. api/cancel.php:58-61 claims "Staff waive the customer-facing cancellation penalty" — the engine does not. admin/api/schedule-action.php:198-211 trip cancel: "Booked/paid seats (booking_seats) are deliberately untouched — the owner decides per-PNR in Refund Desk", so bookings on a company-cancelled trip later go through cancel()/bulkCancel (booking.php:2187 `self::cancel($pnr, $reason, false)`) and get 0-25% refunds inside 24h. forceCancel (2368-2440) gives 0 and says 'handle by hand'.
gaps.proposed_change: Add a refund-policy parameter to cancel(): `string $policy = 'slab'|'full'|'none'`; api/cancel.php passes 'full' when $staffMayCancel (matching its comment), bulkCancel passes the caller's choice, and schedule-action.php trip cancel offers a 'cancel all bookings with full refund' step (via bulkCancel with 'full'). Record the policy in the audit new_value.
gaps.risk: Owner must confirm the operator-cancellation refund rule (100%?). Agents cancelling their own sales should probably keep 'slab' — gate 'full' on bookings.cancel permission.
gaps.test: tests/money-guards-test.php: staff cancel of a confirmed+verified booking 2h before departure → refund 100% when policy 'full', 25% when customer.

gaps.title: SeatVersion does not change after a seat transfer, so live maps and the api/seats.php 'unchanged' short-circuit serve stale seats
gaps.evidence: includes/seatversion.php:32-35 hashes `COUNT(*), MAX(id)` of booking_seats, holds, blocks and `schedules.status,is_blocked,bus_id,coach_type_override,updated_at`. Seats::transferSeat (seats.php:2404-2422) only does `Database::update('booking_seats', ['seat_no' => $toSeat], …)` and `booking_passengers` — count, max id and schedules.updated_at are all unchanged. api/seats.php:49-55 returns `['unchanged' => true]` when the client's ver matches; api/seat-events.php:118-130 only emits on a changed ver. A customer polling after a reseat keeps seeing the old berth sold and the new one free until something else changes.
gaps.proposed_change: In transferSeat (inside the transaction) touch the departure: `Database::run('UPDATE schedules SET updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = :s', …)` — or make SeatVersion fold `MD5(GROUP_CONCAT(seat_no ORDER BY seat_no))` of live booking_seats into the hash so any label change bumps it.
gaps.risk: Low; one extra indexed UPDATE per transfer.
gaps.test: tests/seat-events-test.php: capture SeatVersion::of(sid), transferSeat L3→L7, assert the version changed.

gaps.title: A customer COD booking carrying an agent code posts cash_due to the agent when the crew settles the cash
gaps.evidence: includes/booking.php:500 `'sold_by_admin_id'=> $soldByAdminId` is stamped for an ONLINE booking whose referralCode resolved (booking.php:263-266) and `'is_cod' => $isCod ? 1 : 0`. settleCod → `AgentWallet::accrue($booking)` (booking.php:1934). agentwallet.php:1413-1423 `if ($total > 0 && self::isCashSale($bookingId, $booking)) { insertEntry([... 'entry_type' => 'cash_due', 'amount' => $total …]) }` and isCashSale (1478-1483) returns true for `is_cod === 1` — the referral agent never held that cash (it was collected by the crew/counter, payments.verified_by = the settling admin).
gaps.proposed_change: In AgentWallet::accrue post cash_due only for staff sales: `in_array($booking['source'], ['counter','agent','admin'], true)` (or payments.verified_by === sold_by_admin_id). Commission still accrues for the referral.
gaps.risk: Low; check whether any live agent is legitimately expected to hold cash for app-COD referrals (owner).
gaps.test: tests/agent-wallet-test.php: online isCod booking with agentCode → settleCod → ledger has 'commission' and NO 'cash_due'.

gaps.title: Per-seat cancel inserts a commission_void even when no commission was ever accrued, and ignores commission_agent_only
gaps.evidence: includes/booking.php:2560-2595 `$soldBy = (int) ($locked['sold_by_admin_id'] ?? 0); if ($soldBy > 0 && AgentWallet::enabled()) { $perSeatCommission = AgentWallet::commissionForBooking($perSeatFare, $soldBy, 1); … insert 'commission_void' }` — no check that an 'commission' row exists (pending online booking, COD not yet settled) and no `commission_agent_only`/isAgentRow gate that accrue() applies (agentwallet.php:1372-1374). accrue() later deletes the void (1386-1390), so it self-heals only if the booking is eventually settled; otherwise the agent carries a phantom negative.
gaps.proposed_change: Void only when `SELECT amount FROM agent_ledger WHERE booking_id=:b AND entry_type='commission'` exists, and derive the share from that row (amount × 1/seatsBefore) rather than re-rating at today's rate.
gaps.test: tests/money-guards-test.php M5 extension: per-seat cancel on a pending agent-code booking leaves agent_ledger empty.

gaps.title: cancelSeat computes the fare share and refund from an unlocked pre-transaction read
gaps.evidence: includes/booking.php:2470-2510 `$liveSeats = Database::fetchAll(…)`, `$perSeatFare = round((float) $booking['total_amount'] / $seatCount, 2); $newTotal = …` run BEFORE `Database::transaction` (2515) which then `fetchForUpdate`s the row but still writes the stale `$newTotal`/`$refund` (2531-2533). Two staff cancelling different seats of one booking at once both subtract from the same total.
gaps.proposed_change: Move the live-seat count, per-seat fare and refund computation inside the closure after fetchForUpdate; recompute total_amount from $locked.
gaps.test: DB-backed per-seat-cancel case running two cancelSeat calls sequentially from two 'admins' and asserting total_amount = total − 2×share.

gaps.title: Refund slab hours use the route's dep_time, ignoring schedules.dep_time_override (extra buses) and the passenger's own pickup time
gaps.evidence: includes/booking.php:2259-2265 `SELECT l.travel_date, r.dep_time FROM booking_legs l JOIN schedules s … JOIN routes r` and 2493-2500 (cancelSeat) — the extra-bus override that create() itself honours (`$chosenSchedule['dep_time_override']`, booking.php:316-322) is not used, so a 20:00 extra bus cancelled at 14:00 is judged against the 13:00 daily departure.
gaps.proposed_change: Select `COALESCE(s.dep_time_override, r.dep_time) AS dep_time` in both queries (optionally COALESCE(l.boarding_time, …) first).
gaps.test: money-guards: extra bus with dep_time_override 20:00, cancel at T-7h → 25% slab, not 0%.

gaps.title: Bus-swap safety check runs outside the write transaction (check-then-act)
gaps.evidence: admin/trip-dashboard.php:54-65 `$check = Seats::assertBusSwapSafe($sid, $busId); Database::transaction(static function () … { Database::update('schedules', ['bus_id' => $busId] …` and admin/api/schedule-action.php:979-985 same shape; assertBusSwapSafe is read-only with no row lock (seats.php:2208-2340). A sale committing between the check and the UPDATE is not counted.
gaps.proposed_change: Run assertBusSwapSafe inside the transaction after `Database::fetchForUpdate('SELECT id FROM schedules WHERE id = :s')` — the same lock the sale gate takes, so the swap and any concurrent sale serialise.
gaps.risk: Low; the fleet is all 72-bed sleepers today so capacity refusal is rare.
gaps.test: tests/cross-mode-integrity-test.php bus-swap section: assert the schedule row is locked (SELECT … FOR UPDATE NOWAIT from a second connection fails during the swap).

gaps.title: Refund desk approve/deny is not atomic — two approvals both pass the guard and both notify the customer
gaps.evidence: admin/refunds.php:35-45 reads `$booking = Database::fetch(…)` then checks `refund_status === 'processed'`; the write at :60-64 is `Database::update('bookings', ['refund_amount' => $amount, 'refund_status' => 'processed', 'refund_ref' => $ref], 'id = :i')` without the status in the WHERE and without rowCount checking; Notify::refundProcessed fires regardless.
gaps.proposed_change: `UPDATE … WHERE id = :i AND refund_status IN ('pending','denied')`; if rowCount === 0 throw 'already processed'; same for deny.
gaps.test: HTTP test posting approve twice → second answer 'already processed', one notification row.

gaps.title: commission_agent_only defaults OFF, so manager/superadmin/office counter sales still mint commission + cash_due rows (owner decision pending)
gaps.evidence: includes/agentwallet.php:1372-1374 `if (Settings::getBool('commission_agent_only', false) && !self::isAgentRow($agentId)) { return; }` with the comment "On live the owner's and the counter's own sales carry these rows (≈ ₹10 lakh of cash_due across 272 bookings)"; local settings row commission_agent_only=0. attributeDeskSale (booking.php:716-742) re-owns only the commission row to SHG-0001; the cash_due stays on the office member.
gaps.proposed_change: Owner sign-off, then: default the setting ON (upgrade SQL sets it), and ship a one-time reconciliation script that voids commission rows whose agent_admin_id is not an agent row and reports (not deletes) the cash_due rows for accounting.
gaps.risk: Changes historic agent statements; must be a reversible adjustment, never a delete (UNIQUE(booking_id, entry_type) rule).
gaps.test: money-guards M2 already covers both switch states; add an assertion on the default.

gaps.title: 'Short run' sharing discount setting is dead — no caller passes $stopCount to Fare::cabinFare
gaps.evidence: includes/fare.php:146 `cabinFare(…, int $stopCount = 4)` and :209-212 apply `sharing_short_run_discount_inr` only when `$stopCount < $minFullStops`; every caller omits it: includes/booking.php:2850, includes/booking.php:837, includes/quickticket.php:663, api/quote.php:63. Settings sharing_short_run_min_stops=3 / discount 200 exist locally and are editable, so a configured fare rule has no effect.
gaps.proposed_change: Either compute stopCount from the chosen boarding/drop (route_stops positions) in priceBooking and api/quote.php and pass it, or remove the two settings and the branch so the admin cannot configure a rule that never applies.
gaps.risk: Owner must say whether the short-run discount is a live rule.
gaps.test: tests/fares-settings-test.php: Surat→border with 2 stops prices base−200 when enabled.

gaps.title: schedules.seats_booked counts label rows, not beds — 'free' seat counts in the reschedule/missed-bus pickers are overstated when private cabins are sold
gaps.evidence: includes/seats.php:1388-1396 `SET seats_booked = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM booking_seats WHERE schedule_id = :s1 AND released_at IS NULL)`; admin/reschedule.php:186 `SUM(s.total_seats - s.seats_booked) AS free`; admin/missed-bus.php:153 `(s.total_seats - s.seats_booked) AS free`. A private cabin is 1 row / 2 beds. (api/search.php:313-314 correctly derives seats_booked from availability.)
gaps.proposed_change: Recompute seats_booked from count(Seats::bookedPhysical($sid)) in claim()/release paths, or make the two pickers read Seats::availabilityForSchedule()['availableCount'].
gaps.test: cross-mode-seat-sync-test: after a private L4 sale, seats_booked == 2.

already_satisfied: Same-label double booking is impossible at the DB level: UNIQUE uq_seat_per_schedule(schedule_id, seat_no) (database/schema.sql:381, SHOW INDEX on shari_test) + Seats::claim INSERT IGNORE with owner check (includes/seats.php:1363-1392); tests/double-booking-race-test.php 10/10 PASS locally with 6 real OS processes per scenario (customers, lazy schedule creation with UNIQUE(route_id,travel_date,slot), customer-vs-counterSale, hold race).

Cross-mode (private vs sharing) oversell is closed transactionally: assertAvailable takes the schedule row FOR UPDATE and a LOCK IN SHARE MODE read of occupancy (seats.php:1283, 1345-1351); claim/transfer/block/bus-swap all reason in physical beds; cross-mode-integrity 10/10, cross-mode-hold 32/32, cross-mode-seat-sync 28/28 PASS; nightly DataAudit::seatDoubleBed (dataaudit.php:147-199) re-checks with the same expansion.
